title: A Trump 2024 Campaign Ad Returns, Now Brought to You by the Government
summary: The ad, which ethics experts said could violate federal law, shows Mr. Trump vowing to “expel the warmongers” from the government and fight the “deep state,” even as he wages a war with Iran.
